dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.wing_bar_presence_and_contrast: Single thin pale horizontal band across the greater coverts with high grayscale contrast against the dark wing plumage.
dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: Subtle, thin pale fringes on folded primary feathers with low boundary sharpness.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.nape_patch_geometry: Distinct rectangular pale patch visible on the posterior lateral neck.
crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: Sharp linear transition boundary between the dark crown and the lighter grey-toned mantle.

other_distinctive_markers: Contrast between dark dorsal plumage and a pale yellowish-white region on the lateral-ventral flank.
